content:
Whenever an effect allows you to move (including using the [Advance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/advance) move action), you can automatically long jump a number of squares up to your [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might) or [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility) score (your choice; minimum 1 square) as part of that movement. The height of your jump is automatically 1 square as part of that movement.

If you want to jump even longer or higher than your baseline jump allows, make a [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might) or [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility) [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test):

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might) or [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility):**

- **≤11:** You don't jump any farther than your baseline jump allows.
- **12-16:** You jump 1 square longer and higher than your baseline jump allows.
- **17+:** You jump 2 squares longer and higher than your baseline jump allows.

You can't jump farther or higher than the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of the effect that allows you to move. You can't jump out of [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) or [damaging terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/damaging-terrain) (see below).
name: Jump
